items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: Oh boy, then I had, I was playing 'Body and Soul' and Gene Ramey trying to play a bass solo and I'm holding Spoon with one hand and Emmett Berry with the other hand.

ctx.x: Gene Ramey. And on the bill with us was Dizzy and Dave Brubeck. So that was a nice trip. That was a good trip.
Yes that was a fairly well balanced trip.

items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: I stayed with him. Then I went out and started working with Buck doing, you know, gigs on weekends and things, and we went back to Europe.
